headline:
renter
upgrades
title: Under-$30 changes a landlord will never notice.
items: A washable runner that covers the tired hallway carpet completely
Adhesive hooks rated well above the weight you actually plan to hang
Blackout curtains on an extendable pole that leaves no screw holes
A slim over-the-door rack that turns one door into real storage
Warm-white bulbs everywhere, because overhead white light kills cosiness
One good lamp on a smart plug so evenings start without effort
